name: Susugi Wash
description: Susugi Wash is a calm, single-column WordPress landing theme designed for compact commercial kitchens and preorder product showcases. Built around a precise 50/50 split hero, corner-bracket calls to action, and full-bleed staggered photo galleries, it presents product specifications and fitting timelines with understated clarity. Features responsive typography in Albert Sans and Manrope, accessible block patterns, and seamless multilingual support without external plugin dependencies.

summary.en: A preorder landing page for a compact undercounter dishwasher: a 50/50 split hero with a candid kitchen photograph, corner-bracket calls to action, a parallax pass photograph and a staggered full-bleed photo row.
